label: Investigación por conversación
prompt: Using the attached Cartera de Ruta direction as the locked visual world, create a HIGH-FIDELITY desktop web app north-star composition, 1440x900, for Supply Control MCP. Structure: compact header; narrow vertical itinerary spine at left with stages Riesgo, Material, Recomendacion, Evidencia; conversation workspace in the center where answers form connected ticket coupons; inspection column at right with selected material, risk factors, deterministic recommendation and service state; visible protocol drawer along the bottom with the active MCP tool and JSON-RPC trace. Preserve warm paper, carrier navy, signal red, carbon purple, perforated seams, barcode and stamp accents, condensed headings, sans body, mono evidence. Use authentic Spanish UI copy and synthetic data. Primary action: Ejecutar recomendacion. Accessible contrast and labeled statuses. Minimal radius, no gradients, no generic SaaS cards, no map, no airplane overload. Emphasize conversation-first investigation, progressive disclosure and cause-to-evidence linkage.
